cases.instruction_en: Walk forward through the hallway, passing a bedroom on your left and a bedroom on your right. Continue straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom entrance on your left. Enter the open room, keeping the dining table and chairs on your left. Turn slightly to your right and stop in the main open area, with the dining table on your left and a living area with a couch on your right.

Turn right to enter the dining area, keeping the dining table and a patterned sofa on your right. Walk forward, passing the dining table on your right and a kitchen entrance on your left. Proceed straight down the hallway, then turn left to enter the living room. Stop in front of the window, with the sofa on your left.

Turn right into the main area, keeping the green wall art on your left and framed pictures on your right. Walk forward, passing a doorway to a room with a window on your left, and then a tall shelving unit also on your left. Turn left to face the bathroom entrance, with a coat rack on your right. Immediately turn left again, passing a large circular wall art on your left, and walk into the open living space. Proceed past the dining table and chairs on your right, then enter the kitchen. Stop in front of the kitchen counter, between the built-in ovens and the sink, directly facing the window.

Turn right from the room and go through the open doorway into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your left and an artwork on your right. Continue straight through the next doorway to enter the open living and dining area, keeping the living room with a couch on your left. Walk towards the dining table on your right. Pass the dining table on your left, and stop at the entrance of the kitchen on your right.

Walk straight, passing the living room area on your left and the kitchen doorway on your right. Enter the hallway and proceed straight down the hallway. At the end of the hallway, turn left to enter the bedroom. Stop in front of the window, with a desk and chair on your left and a bunk bed on your right.

Go through the doorway and enter the room with white cabinets on your left. Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing an opening on your left and another on your right. Enter the large open room at the end of the hallway, then turn right. Walk past the dining table on your left, and continue forward to stop in front of the large TV screen.

Walk forward through the doorway into the main room, passing a low wooden bench on your right. Turn left, keeping the large painting and console table with two tall plants on your right. Enter the hallway, walking straight ahead past a dining room on your left, then turn right to enter a small room. Stop in front of the window.

Walk forward, passing a dining table on your left and an entryway table on your right, which is attached to a dividing wall. Continue straight past the dividing wall, then turn right to enter the bathroom. Proceed straight, with a window on your left and a toilet in front of you. Stop in front of the shower area.
